exact_statement: For h negative exactly on {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}, let g be the six-bit sign negative only at zero. With B_i the spectral conditional entropy in bits and E=min relevant B_i/Inf_i, E(g)>9/4 whereas E(h(g^6))<9/4 and E(h((-g)^6))<9/4, using disjoint identical copies. All 36 physical coordinates in each composition are equal by actual permutation symmetry. Thus neither a universal nonnegative signed admission reserve nor an arbitrary-K threshold transfer, even with a choice of output sign, holds for this gate. Separately 323/100<E(h(h^6))<324/100. The 559 achievable six-bit bias/singleton-square signatures have 440 positive,31 zero,88 negative signed reserves; the 288 signatures with p<=1/2 have 233 positive,16 zero,39 negative reserves. These are scoped finite statements and do not refute admission restricted to E(g)>=K6 or prove/disprove FEI.
